statement_summary: Program covers IT and OT; documented in policies, SSP, and the TSA plan
Primary and alternate Cybersecurity Coordinators; U.S. citizen; TSA updates within 7 days
Annual IT and OT risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk acceptance authority by level; no control or safety risk accepted above Moderate
Quarterly audit committee reporting, including TSA matters
Annual policy and standard review
Written, risk-rated, time-limited exceptions; Coordinator review for TSA measures
Security changes to OT go through MOC with Gas Control sign-off
TSA plan amendment check in every MOC; file within 50 days
Supplier security terms before OT or SSI access; purchasing gate
Annual Tier 1 supplier reassessment with SOC 2 review
Assessments under the TSA assessment plan: one-third per year, architecture review every 2 years
Security and TSA records kept 5 years; PHMSA records per rule
AI tools approved through P10 before use
Unique accounts on all business and OT systems
Shared accounts only where operationally necessary; password changed within 24 hours of departure
Role-based least privilege; Gas Control approval for OT roles; no self-approval of SCADA changes
Named OT privileged accounts; no more than 4 OT domain administrators; quarterly review
MFA for remote and privileged access; documented compensating controls for HMIs
Remote access to OT only through the gateways with approval and recording; other paths prohibited
Access removed within 1 business day of termination; transfers cleaned within 5 days
Quarterly access reviews including OT and field devices
Password reset schedule with documented mitigations and timeframes; no defaults
No trust between OT and business domains; annual trust review
Badge-only physical access; quarterly control room access review
TSA incident response plan with runbooks, positions, and resources; integrated with 192.615
Report suspected incidents immediately; OT anomalies to the controller at once
Log every incident with identification time and severity
Controllers act for safety without waiting for IT
Director of Gas Control may isolate OT at any time; live isolation once a year
Precautionary shutdown only under the P08 criteria with COO approval
Prompt containment, segregation, memory capture, labeling; backup integrity before restore
Report to CISA within 72 hours; supplemental information within 24 hours
Other notices per the P08 matrix; Part 191 decisions by Pipeline Safety
No ransom without OFAC check, counsel, insurer, CEO and board chair
Annual exercise testing at least two objectives with named positions
Lessons learned within 30 days into the risk register, POA&M, and controller training
Five classification levels including SSI
Encrypt SSI and Restricted data at rest and in transit where supported
SSI and Restricted data only in approved locations
Inventory of SSI and Restricted locations; quarterly file share scan
SCADA and PLC backups, offline copy at the BCC, integrity checks, annual rebuild test
Wipe or destroy media with SSI or Restricted data
SSI marked, need-to-know only, stored securely, destroyed; exposures reported to TSA
CEII filings follow 18 CFR 388.113(d); company copies Restricted
192.631 and TSA compliance records protected from alteration
Business use; no personal use on OT
Acknowledgment at hire and annually
Awareness and role-based training; briefing on TSA directives
Screen lock for business IT; HMI exemption
No software, media, or devices on OT without scan and approval
Company-managed devices only; encrypted field tablets
Report anything unusual immediately
Approved AI tools only; no SSI or Restricted data in others; model is advisory
No photos of control room screens or OT equipment except approved work
